Where a bare URL ends. Punctuation at its end is the sentence's; a ) or ]
is the URL's only when the URL opened it. The format is link.txt's.

~~ case: a period
See https://x.org.
~~ want
<p id="p1">See <a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a>.</p>
~~ case: a period inside stays
https://x.org/a.html
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org/a.html">https://x.org/a.html</a></p>
~~ case: an ellipsis
https://x.org/a...
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org/a">https://x.org/a</a>...</p>
~~ case: a comma
https://x.org/a, and then
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org/a">https://x.org/a</a>, and then</p>
~~ case: a colon
at https://x.org: the page
~~ want
<p id="p1">at <a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a>: the page</p>
~~ case: a colon and a port inside stay
https://x.org:8080/a
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org:8080/a">https://x.org:8080/a</a></p>
~~ case: a semicolon
https://x.org; then
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a>; then</p>
~~ case: a question mark and an exclamation mark
is it https://x.org/a? yes https://x.org/b!
~~ want
<p id="p1">is it <a href="https://x.org/a">https://x.org/a</a>? yes <a href="https://x.org/b">https://x.org/b</a>!</p>
~~ case: a query with an empty value stays whole
https://x.org/?a=
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org/?a=">https://x.org/?a=</a></p>
~~ case: a trailing slash stays
https://x.org/a/.
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org/a/">https://x.org/a/</a>.</p>
~~ case: in parentheses
(see https://x.org)
~~ want
<p id="p1">(see <a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a>)</p>
~~ case: in parentheses, then a period
(on the dev channel at http://x.org/tutorial.fresh/).
~~ want
<p id="p1">(on the dev channel at <a href="http://x.org/tutorial.fresh/">http://x.org/tutorial.fresh/</a>).</p>
~~ case: a parenthesis the URL opened
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_(language)
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_(language)">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_(language)</a></p>
~~ case: a parenthesis the URL opened, inside parentheses
(https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_(language)).
~~ want
<p id="p1">(<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_(language)">https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Go_(language)</a>).</p>
~~ case: in square brackets
[https://x.org]
~~ want
<p id="p1">[<a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a>]</p>
~~ case: in double quotes
"https://x.org"
~~ want
<p id="p1">&quot;<a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a>&quot;</p>
~~ case: in single quotes
'https://x.org'
~~ want
<p id="p1">'<a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a>'</p>
~~ case: in curly quotes
“https://x.org”
~~ want
<p id="p1">“<a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a>”</p>
~~ case: an em dash straight after
https://x.org—and more
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a>—and more</p>
~~ case: an underscore at its end
https://x.org/a_
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org/a">https://x.org/a</a>_</p>
~~ case: bold, then a period
**https://metal.lynrummy.com**.
~~ want
<p id="p1"><strong><a href="https://metal.lynrummy.com">https://metal.lynrummy.com</a></strong>.</p>
~~ case: a backtick straight after
https://x.org`code`
~~ want
<p id="p1"><a href="https://x.org">https://x.org</a><code>code</code></p>
